This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, for Mitsubishi frame 2 steam 
turbine, generator, which must be performed on an annual bases as indicated by 
Y1in the title block

The first draft is initiated by eng. Eman El henawey, tested by eng. Wageh 
khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC. quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of nubaria 
power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
sector

items: A work permit must be issued

Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified

Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place

sections.text: Cleaning fluids such as freon - TF, chlorothene

items: Brushes
Blower
Cleaning fluids such as freon - TF, chlorothene

Check for existence of oil and any other foreign matters remaining inside 
 generator

Check each coil for any distortion, insulation, deterioration, damage or 
 soiling

Check ventilation duets for any deformation, spacers that have slipped out, 
 binding ropes loosened, wedges seasoned or loosened and connection parts 
 discolored by overheating

Check the stator core for any discoloration or damage by overheating clamping 
 bolts, loosened and ventilation ducts soiled

Insulation resistance of the stator core through - bolt to clamp is measured 
 with 1000 V megger and the minimum acceptable value should be more than 100 
 megohms for operation

Insulation resistance of the stator coil is measured with 1000 V megger and 
 the acceptable value should be more than 50 megohms for operation
Check if temperature detectors and lead wires are damaged or loosened

Insulation resistance of rotor coil is measured 
 with 500 V megger and the minimum acceptable value of more than 10 megohms for 
 operation

Check to see if balance weights and locking 
 stoppers are loosened

Check to see if journal parts of shaft are worn 
 or damaged

Leakage test for the center bore is conducted 
 with nitrogen gas at radial lead and the pressure drop is cionsidered suitable 
 for operation

After leakage test, the center bore should be 
 bowled with nitrogen gas at 0.5 -1 bar gage sufficiently and closed keenly 
 with plug on remaining the pressure at 0.5 bar gage

text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the equipment inspection I1, for Mitsubishi frame 2 steam 
turbine, generator, which must be performed on an annual bases as indicated by 
Y1in the title block
The first draft is initiated by eng. Eman El henawey, tested by eng. Wageh 
khalil, revised by MDEPCo. Quality control eng. Adel El Naggar, accepted by eng. 
Ali Zahran, general manager & eng. Samir Abd El Gillil MDEPC. quality control 
general director, approved by eng. Ahmed Sawwan head sector of nubaria 
power station and certified by eng. Mohammed Nageb inspection and quality head 
sector
Quantity | 2
Manufacture | Mitsubishi
Serial numbers | 03 GRSY 01 / 03 GRSZ 01
Type | Cylindrical rotor, with brush, synchronous
Out put | 264.350 MW , 311 MVA
Voltage | 15 kv
Current | 11.970 k.Amp
Phase | (3)
Insulation | Class F system
Stator winding | 72slots with two layer lap winding
Number of poles | (2)
Safety 
Precautions
A work permit must be issued
Personal protective equipment must be used (safety shoes, helmet, breathing 
 mask, safety glasses)
Maintenance staff should be well trained and qualified
Caution marks must be hanged on the work place, safety rope around the work 
 place
Tools and 
Equipment
Brushes
Blower
Cleaning fluids such as freon - TF, chlorothene
Megger. (500 - 5000 V)
Brushes
Blower
Cleaning fluids such as freon - TF, chlorothene
Megger. (500 - 5000 V)
Work to be carried out
Inspection and maintenance of 
stator
Check for existence of oil and any other foreign matters remaining inside 
 generator
Check each coil for any distortion, insulation, deterioration, damage or 
 soiling
Check ventilation duets for any deformation, spacers that have slipped out, 
 binding ropes loosened, wedges seasoned or loosened and connection parts 
 discolored by overheating
Check the stator core for any discoloration or damage by overheating clamping 
 bolts, loosened and ventilation ducts soiled
Insulation resistance of the stator core through - bolt to clamp is measured 
 with 1000 V megger and the minimum acceptable value should be more than 100 
 megohms for operation
Insulation resistance of the stator coil is measured with 1000 V megger and 
 the acceptable value should be more than 50 megohms for operation
Check if temperature detectors and lead wires are damaged or loosened
Insulation resistance of rotor coil is measured 
 with 500 V megger and the minimum acceptable value of more than 10 megohms for 
 operation
Check to see if balance weights and locking 
 stoppers are loosened
Check to see if journal parts of shaft are worn 
 or damaged
Leakage test for the center bore is conducted 
 with nitrogen gas at radial lead and the pressure drop is cionsidered suitable 
 for operation
After leakage test, the center bore should be 
 bowled with nitrogen gas at 0.5 -1 bar gage sufficiently and closed keenly 
 with plug on remaining the pressure at 0.5 bar gage
